'''Susan K. Blessing''' (born April 10, 1961) is an American physicist who is currently a professor at [[Florida State University]] and an elected fellow of the [[American Physical Society]].

==Early life and education==
Blessing was born on April 10, 1961.<ref>{{cite web |title=Blessing, Susan K., 1961- |url=https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no92016155.html |publisher=Library of Congress |access-date=December 20, 2021}}</ref> She earned her B.S. at [[Illinois Institute of Technology]] in 1982 and her Ph.D at [[Indiana University]] in 1989.<ref name="FSUbio">{{Cite web |url=http://web2.physics.fsu.edu/~blessing/bio.html |title=Bio |publisher=fsu.edu |accessdate=December 27, 2017}}</ref>  After earning her Ph.D., she was a research associate at [[Northwestern University]] from 1989-1993.

==Career==
Blessing joined Florida State University in 1994 as an Assistant Professor in physics rising to Professor by 2007.<ref name="FSUbio"/>  She has served as Director of the Women in Math, Science, and Engineering (WIMSE) program since 2005.  From 2010-12, she held the Nancy Marcus Professorship. She served as the Chair of the American Physical Society Forum on Education from 2023-2024.<ref>{{cite web |title=Executive Committee |url=https://engage.aps.org/fed/governance/executive-committee/past-officers |website=American Physical Society |access-date=21 May 2024 |ref=APS FEd Chairship}}</ref>

==Research==
Her academic interest is in particle physics.<ref name="FSUbio"/> Her highest cited paper is "Transverse energy distributions within jets in collisions at TeV"<ref>{{cite journal | last=Abachi | first=S. | last2=Abbott | first2=B. | last3=Abolins | first3=M. | last4=Acharya | first4=B.S. | last5=Adam | first5=I. | last6=Adams | first6=D.L. | last7=Adams | first7=M. | last8=Ahn | first8=S. | last9=Aihara | first9=H. | last10=Alitti | first10=J. | display-authors=5|collaboration=DØ Collaboration| title=Transverse energy distributions within jets in collisions at <math>\sqrt{s}</math>=1.8 TeV| journal=Physics Letters B | publisher=Elsevier BV | volume=357 | issue=3 | year=1995 | issn=0370-2693 | doi=10.1016/0370-2693(95)00889-s | pages=500–508| doi-access=free }}</ref> at 100 times, according to [[Google Scholar]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C44&q=Susan+Blessing&btnG= |title=Susan Blessing |accessdate=December 27, 2017}}</ref>
